刮削库用于存放可供刮削使用的资源数据。这里的记录是「固有数据」（不含游玩时长、评: The scraper library holds resource data used for scraping. These records are base data (no play time, ratings, or play history). They come mainly from resource tables in your save, and are used to match and fill in metadata while scraping.
从当前应用的存档中，将各资源表里已有的数据导入到刮削库。导入的是不含 id 的固: Import existing data from each resource table in the current save into the scraper library. The import is base data without an id, so you can reuse it elsewhere or when merging.
选择另一个刮削库文件（如从其它群友那里得到的scraper-library.db: Choose another scraper library file (for example a scraper-library.db from someone else) and merge it with this one. For duplicates (same json or name), choose Overwrite to replace local data, or Ignore to keep it. Everything else is added.
